result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.rescale_node_attrs()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Rescale node attribute values to a range. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L8454-L8585){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.rescale_node_attrs( node_attr_from=None, values=None, node_attr_to="size", range=None, nodes=None ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Normalizes numeric values to a specified range, useful for sizing nodes by centrality, degree, or other continuous metrics. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [node_attr_from]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Attribute name to read values from (e.g., 'betweenness', 'degree'). If `None`, must provide values dict. [values]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [dict[str, int | float]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Dictionary mapping node IDs to numeric values. If `None`, reads from the `node_attr_from=` attribute. [node_attr_to]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [["size"]{.st}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Attribute name to write rescaled values to. [range]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [list[float]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Output range as [min, max]. Values will be rescaled to this range. [nodes]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Optional[list[str]]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Subset of nodes to rescale (default: all nodes). ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Self for method chaining ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Size by betweenness centrality: ::: {#8959a44d .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec G = ec.Graph() for i in range(5): G.add_node(label=str(i)) G.add_edge(source="0", target="1") G.add_edge(source="1", target="2") G.add_edge(source="2", target="3") G.add_edge(source="3", target="4") # Calculate betweenness and rescale to node sizes betweenness = G.betweenness_centrality(return_dict=True) G.rescale_node_attrs( values=betweenness, node_attr_to="size", range=[5, 20] ) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` Number of nodes : 5 Number of edges : 4 Directed : False Density : 0.40 Average degree (min, max) : 1.60 (1, 2) Connected : True Number of connected components : 1 Tree : True Bipartite : True Node aesthetics: - size <- values via rescale (range: [5, 20]) (values: 16.25, 20.0, 5.0, 5 of 5 nodes) ``` ::: ::: Scale by degree: ::: {#12f2a7fe .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} # Create a simple graph G = ec.Graph() for i in range(4): G.add_node(label=str(i)) G.add_edge(source="0", target="1") G.add_edge(source="0", target="2") G.add_edge(source="0", target="3") # Calculate degrees and rescale degrees = {n: len(G.neighbors(node=n)) for n in G.get_node_ids(limit=None)} G.rescale_node_attrs( values=degrees, node_attr_to="width", range=[1, 10] ) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` Number of nodes : 4 Number of edges : 3 Directed : False Density : 0.50 Average degree (min, max) : 1.50 (1, 3) Connected : True Number of connected components : 1 Tree : True Bipartite : True Node aesthetics: - width <- values via rescale (range: [1, 10]) (values: 1.0, 10.0, 4 of 4 nodes) ``` ::: :::
